disclosureBaselineAndInjectedCSSComparis.method: Live read-only baseline with source-equivalent CSS/DOM class injected for targeted before/after layout checks.

notes: Desktop1440x1000 only; phone-specific findings intentionally deferred by user.
Closed disclosure controls had phantom geometry in Chrome but were already invisible, unfocusable and not hit-testable. Explicit hiding removes that geometry.
Assistant pending-state disabling/loading was already implemented; actual pending submission was held then released to real missing-context validation without calling the AI provider.
RSC navigation was held then released to actual server response to inspect persistent shell and loading state. No synthetic server response was substituted.

Full password booking-return flow and real admin-generated magic-link callback with return-cookie consumption were verified. No email was sent; external OAuth consent/code-email delivery were not exercised.
One initial production assistant page navigation exceeded30s; the final complete run passed with a60s navigation deadline.
Filter clearing initially retained dirty input values after transition; a form key tied to committed filters fixed it and the local/live regression passed.
Big Shoulders uses font-display:optional to avoid late font replacement. No numerical CLS benchmark is claimed.
